title: Isolate job-lane run data; share only via brokered observe or handoff
narrative: Fangore's product treats each pipeline identity as a JobLane (e.g. assets.generate vs billing.settle). Runs in the same lane may observe earlier runs in that lane's sequence; other lanes must not see bags, meta, or artifact URLs unless the publisher's exposure policy and/or standing grants (or a one-shot HandoffRecord) allow it. Related: `fangore_insp_isolation_io` (subgraph I/O contracts), `fangore_insp_handoff_record` (handoff schema). Tracks MH-DOTS-07[^insp-dots-07]; product shape is JobLaneBroker[^jl-broker].
implementation: Target: `JobLane` + `JobLaneBroker` (JL-01..10) owning per-lane run sequences and WalkBags; `observe` with selectors latest / before(t) / run_id; exposure policy on meta and keys. Interim probe still exercises `CrossTaskIsolationGuard` until the broker lands and this story retargets into the JL story matrix in `docs/requirements/job-lane-broker.md`.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/cross_task_isolation_bleed.yaml` until migration; then `user_story` multi-lane YAML with step-level `lane` / `lane_observe` expects grant vs deny.
